text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, we meet in front of the station at 9 tomorrow.
Make sure you don't forget.
choice_data_list: What's this about all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't you hear?
...No, I suppose I hadn't told you. Well, no matter."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Thanks to connections through an acquaintance, I can get experimental equipment and chemicals on the cheap.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The experiment I'm running right now is at its crucial peak,
so I need the equipment right away.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Listen, you're carrying the luggage. 9:00 AM in front of the station, don't forget to show up.

The next morning, I waited outside the station at 9:00—
but 10:00 came and went, then 11:00,
and Agnes Tachyon was nowhere to be seen.
Just as I was wondering if something had happened, Agnes Tachyon's name flashed on my phone with an incoming call.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Kuh... Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Behind... the school building... Come... quick...!"
(Thud)

Just what is going on...!?
Are they behind the school building?
I decided to hurry over.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hey there... Trainer-kun...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "I was conducting an experiment here... and then... I began to lose consciousness..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
She seemed so absorbed in her experiments
that she had forgotten to eat for a while...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Protein, vitamins, carbohydrates,
all kinds of nutrients are...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, my consciousness is fading again...
Trainer, give me... some... nourishment...
choice_data_list: Hang in there and wait for me!
I'll get it ready right now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Hurry up...

I piled whatever caught my eye in the cafeteria onto a plate
and brought it over to Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was a feast.
Goodness, that was a close one.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It was well worth the wait.
Good work, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Still... Haha, that was quite a pile!
Just how much of a worrywart are you?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Phew... Anyway, that was a huge help.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be sure to be careful not to
forget to eat from now on."

While rubbing her stomach,
Agnes Tachyon wore a satisfied expression, as if she had learned something.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Please hurry...

I bought some easy-to-eat items like jelly at the school store
and delivered them to Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Phew... I feel revived!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly...
This is what happens when you take your eyes off me!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you are to call yourself my assistant,
you had best watch your step.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. For future convenience,
perhaps I should develop an emergency call button just for you.

I asked her to ensure there wouldn't be a next time,
but Agnes Tachyon just wore a satisfied look,
as if she had learned something valuable.
